content: Aside from the lack of training data, we also address the absence of a benchmark dataset of Armenian texts for named entity recognition. We propose a gold-standard corpus with manual annotation of CoNLL named entity categories: person, location, and organization BIBREF8 BIBREF9 , hoping it will be used to evaluate future named entity recognition models.
